news.title: Tollywood Faces Financial Reality Check as Streaming Platforms Slash Budgets
news.summary: The Telugu film industry is confronting a significant financial shift as digital streaming platforms scale back their acquisition budgets. After heavily relying on post-theatrical streaming revenues in recent years, producers of both medium-budget projects and large-scale ventures are finding that current OTT offers fall well short of expectations. With deals increasingly tied to theatrical performance, filmmakers are being forced to refocus on box-office viability and controlled production costs.
